step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage fully differential CMOS operational amplifier with common-mode feedback (CMFB) and cascoded output buffer
step1_figure.description: Figure 26.33 displays the complete schematic of the two-stage fully differential op-amp incorporating an active CMFB network and a cascoded NMOS pull-down output buffer (introduced in Fig. 26.32) to prevent output swing compression and excessive quiescent current.

open_loop_differential_gain.description: Low-frequency differential open-loop voltage gain (A_OL) of the operational amplifier

equation.formula: A_OL = g_m_in * (r_o_n || r_o_p)_stage1 * g_m_out * (r_o_p || r_o_cascode_n || R_load)_stage2
equation.explanation: Two-stage differential gain with loading from the 20k CMFB sensing resistors and 20k feedback resistors.
equation.assumptions: Diff-pair input devices operate in saturation; output stage cascode provides high output resistance.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_tail = 20 uA (10 uA per branch), g_m_in = sqrt(2 * un*Cox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 10u) = 232 uA/V. Output buffer PMOS (40/1): I_D = 40 uA, g_m2 = sqrt(2 * 50u * 40 * 40u) = 400 uA/V. With 20k load resistors in parallel, r_out2 ~ 10 kOhm. Total DC gain ~ 250 - 400 V/V (48 - 52 dB).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Consistent with Figure 26.34 where peak derivative/gain deriv(vop - vom) reaches ~360 - 400 V/V (51 dB).

cmfb_forward_gain.description: Forward voltage gain from the CMFB control input (VCMFB) to the op-amp outputs

equation.explanation: Change in output voltage caused by variations in the VCMFB bias line through the center bias NMOS devices.
equation.assumptions: Small signal perturbation around nominal VCMFB operating point (~400-500 mV).

sky130_expected.calculation: As discussed in the text (p. 882), the forward CMFB gain is approximately 10 times lower than the differential gain, A_CMFB_fwd ~ 25 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly stated on page 882: 'the gain is approximately 25 (about 10 times less than the differential gain)'.

cmfb_error_amp_gain.description: Voltage gain of the differential CMFB error amplifier with current mirror load

equation.explanation: Gain from the averaged output common-mode node (vcma) to the control output node VCMFB.
equation.assumptions: Diff-pair with current-mirror load operating in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: Stated on page 882 for Fig. 26.28b: CMFB amplifier with current mirror load achieves a gain of approximately 8 V/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Explicitly reported on page 882: 'gives a gain of approximately 8'.

cmfb_loop_gain.description: Total open-loop gain of the common-mode feedback loop

equation.explanation: Product of the CMFB error amplifier gain and the op-amp forward CMFB gain.

sky130_expected.reasoning: As derived in textbook text on page 882: 'This combined with the op-amp's CMFB gain gives an overall CMFB loop gain of 200'.

output_common_mode_voltage.description: DC quiescent common-mode voltage at the differential outputs (vop + vom)/2

equation.explanation: Regulated common-mode voltage set by the reference voltage VCM.

sky130_expected.calculation: The CMFB reference voltage in the netlist is VCM = 500 mV (0.5 V). The regulated output common-mode tracks VCM within the CMFB loop error: V_OCM = VCM + offset ~ 0.5 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeted ideal common-mode voltage stated as 500 mV on page 884.

differential_output_swing.description: Maximum peak-to-peak differential output voltage swing before saturation/clipping

equation.explanation: Single-ended output swings close to supply rails due to the cascoded NMOS buffer device.
equation.assumptions: Outputs swing between V_DS,sat of NMOS cascode and V_SD,sat of PMOS.

sky130_expected.calculation: For 1.8V VDD (or 1.0V as in textbook text), the outputs swing between ~100 mV and VDD - 100 mV. For VDD=1.8V, single-ended swing is ~0.15 V to 1.65 V, giving differential swing > 2.8 V peak-to-peak.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Figure 26.34 shows single-ended outputs swinging from < 50 mV to > 950 mV on a 1.0V supply.

total_quiescent_current.description: Total quiescent current drawn from the VDD power supply

equation.explanation: 11 internal branches with ~20 uA each, plus output buffers (doubled), CMFB amplifier, and bias circuit.
equation.assumptions: All branches properly biased in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With 11 core branches at ~20 uA each plus bias circuit pulling ~50 uA, ideal total current is ~270 uA. With output buffer modifications and cascode, current remains near 270 - 350 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Page 884 calculates ~270 uA nominal quiescent current.

large_signal_step_response_settling.description: Settling time of closed-loop differential output (vop - vom) to within 1% for a +/-400mV differential step

equation.formula: t_settle = t(V_diff within 1% of final) - t_step
equation.explanation: Transient response in inverting feedback topology with 250 fF load capacitors.
equation.assumptions: Input vip - vim steps symmetrically with 1 ns rise/fall time.

sky130_expected.calculation: In Fig. 26.35, the differential signal settles smoothly within a 5 ns window (half period of 10 ns, 100 MHz clock rate).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Demonstrated in Fig. 26.35 with clean settling over each 5 ns half-cycle.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench measuring DC operating point (quiescent current, common-mode output), DC differential sweep (open-loop/closed-loop DC transfer and output swing), AC loop gain, and transient large-signal step response matching Baker Fig. 26.35.
